ValidationRule.description: Prevents FraudX Agent, Join Lead or Business Admin from changing status from 'Potential Fraud' to either 'Daon Failed' or 'Equifax Failed'
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c ), NOT( $Permission.ANZx_Edit_COB_Case_Status ), RecordType.DeveloperName = "ID_Ops_Assistance", ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status ), "Potential Fraud"), OR( ISPICKVAL( Status, "Daon Failed" ), ISPICKVAL( Status, "Equifax Failed" ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not allowed to change the status from 'Potential Fraud' to either 'Daon Failed' or 'Equifax Failed'.
